# Complete annotated resource index

Last primary-source check: **20 October 2026**. See the [reading route](README.md) before choosing resources. Durations marked as estimates are curator estimates; self-paced entries do not imply a completion time. Access labels describe the learning resource, with execution costs noted separately.

## Stage 1 · Foundations & deliberate prompting

### [AI Fluency: Framework and foundations](https://academy.claude.com/courses/ai-fluency-framework-foundations)

**Course · Anthropic / Claude Academy · Foundation · Free · self-paced**

A structured starting point for deciding what to delegate, describing work and checking the result.

**Do next:** Select one weekly QA task. Write a delegation brief, then list the decisions you still own.

**Access/context:** Public course material; sign-in saves progress. Product use may require separate access.

**Verification (2026-10-20):** Opened the official primary-source page and checked its title and subject coverage. This is a link/content check, not completion of the course or execution of its code.

### [LLM Course](https://huggingface.co/learn/llm-course/chapter1/1)

**Course · Hugging Face · Foundation · Free · self-paced**

Develop practical understanding of tokenizers, model use and the Hugging Face ecosystem.

**Do next:** Tokenize ten tricky inputs, including Unicode and code. Compare token count with character count.

**Access/context:** Course reading is free. Optional compute or hosted inference is separate.

**Verification (2026-10-20):** Opened the official primary-source page and checked its title and subject coverage. This is a link/content check, not completion of the course or execution of its code.

### [Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.03172)

**Paper · Nelson F. Liu et al. / arXiv · Advanced · Free · 45 min reading estimate**

A research prompt to test position sensitivity instead of assuming context capacity guarantees reliable use.

**Do next:** Move the same critical fact to the start, middle and end of a fixed packet. Compare results on your selected current model.

**Access/context:** Historical findings about the models evaluated in the paper; do not assume identical behavior in current models.

**Verification (2026-10-20):** Opened the official primary-source page and checked its title and subject coverage. This is a link/content check, not completion of the course or execution of its code.
